modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: A Saver ticket still includes the standard cabin-bag allowance.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One carry-on bag up to 22 x 14 x 9 inches, including wheels and handles, plus one smaller personal item.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The allowance depends on route, cabin, ticketing date and eligible benefits. Check the policy shown on your booking.

north_america_fees.value: For tickets issued on or after April 10, 2026, standard North America Main Cabin/Saver fees are USD 45 for the first bag and USD 55 for the second. Hawaii interisland pricing differs.

standard_bag_limit.value: Standard bags may weigh up to 50 lb and measure up to 62 linear inches.

first_class_allowance.value: Passengers confirmed in First Class at check-in receive two bags up to 70 lb each. Later upgrades do not refund bag fees already paid.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: Saver trades seat choice and flexibility for a lower fare while retaining Main Cabin onboard amenities.

seat_assignment.value: Seats are assigned at check-in; groups are not guaranteed seats together.

cabin_baggage.value: Saver includes the same carry-on allowance as Main. Saver passengers normally board in group F, when overhead space may be limited.

cancellation_credit.value: A Saver ticket cancelled at least 14 days before the first departure is eligible for a 50% credit. Outside the 24-hour cancellation policy, other refunds are restricted.

changes.value: Eligible same-day confirmed changes are available for a fee; other changes and standby are not allowed.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Airline-caused disruption is handled separately from the restrictions on voluntarily changing a Saver ticket.

rebooking.value: For cancellation or significant delay, Alaska offers the next available Alaska or Hawaiian flight without an additional charge.

meals.value: For a controllable delay of two hours or more, passengers continuing their journey are offered a reasonable meal voucher at the airport.

overnight_care.value: For a controllable overnight disruption at least 100 miles from home, accommodation and hotel transport are provided subject to availability; reasonable reimbursement applies when voucher hotels are unavailable.

refund_options.value: Alaska says it will tell eligible passengers about refund entitlement before offering alternative transport or credits. Weather and other uncontrollable events can exclude the listed amenities.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: These are completion deadlines, not recommended airport arrival times. Join the bag-drop queue well beforehand.

domestic_cutoff.value: For domestic U.S. flights, check-in and bag acceptance close 50 minutes before departure.

international_cutoff.value: International check-in and bag acceptance close 60 minutes before departure; Guadalajara requires 90 minutes.

airport_exceptions.value: King Salmon and Dillingham require 60 minutes. The published Hawaii interisland cutoff is 30 minutes. Pets travelling in the hold have earlier deadlines.

boarding_cutoff.value: Be checked in and available at the gate at least 30 minutes before departure.

modules.title: Contact and the small print
modules.lede: Use Alaska's help centre for booking support and the published contract for the terms governing travel.
